description.fun: Sandile swims through desert sand with only its nose and eyes showing, and a dark membrane over its eyes works like built-in sunglasses. The sun-warmed sand keeps it from getting cold. It ambushes prey by chomping on the legs of anything that walks over it, Trapinch being its favourite, but it isn't much of a hunter yet, so it mostly eats things that collapse in the desert: it's called 'the cleaner of the desert'.
description.guide: Sandile is a Ground- and Dark-type crocodile Pokémon that lives buried in desert sand, with a dark membrane protecting its eyes from the sun. It ambushes prey from below the surface. It evolves into Krokorok and then Krookodile.
description.tagline: A sand-swimming baby croc in built-in sunglasses.

description.fun: The membrane around Krokorok's eyes senses heat, so it can see in the dark, yet it barely moves at night because it hates the cold. Krokorok live in small groups, usually led by a female, while the males go out to gather food. It buries some of its prey in the sand as emergency rations for when a hunt goes badly. Its Japanese name, Waruvile, begins with warui, 'bad'.
description.guide: Krokorok is the evolved form of Sandile, a Ground- and Dark-type crocodile that lives in small desert groups. The membranes covering its eyes sense heat, letting it see in the dark. It evolves into Krookodile.
description.tagline: A night-vision desert croc that stashes snacks in the sand.

description.fun: Krookodile, the 'Bully of the Sands', has jaws that can crush a car and bite through heavy iron plates, and it never lets its prey escape. Its eyes focus like binoculars to spot small prey far away. It's terribly aggressive yet patient, lying hidden under the sand for days, and it teams up with Flygon, hiding in the sandstorms Flygon whips up and splitting the catch.
description.guide: Krookodile is the final form of Sandile, a Ground- and Dark-type crocodile Pokémon with powerful jaws and long-range eyesight. It is very aggressive and hides under the sand to ambush its prey.
description.tagline: The Bully of the Sands, with car-crushing jaws and binocular eyes.
